这是 DM 对完整实测的综合与下一方向问题，不是 Pro 原文。

同信息、同交互和更新预算的 FACTOR/GENERIC 比较已完成三个独立训练种子，每臂每种子 128 次真实更新。FACTOR 终点差依次为 −0.041667、+0.083333、+0.083333；固定全曲线 AUC 差依次为 −0.028646、+0.033854、+0.023438。三种子平均终点差 +0.041667，平均 AUC 差 +0.009549。首个负结果保留；这只支持训练实例敏感的小幅 B/EXPLORE 信号，不能证明稳定优势或通用 MARL 效果。

当前问题：继续这一公开固定伙伴计划的小 toy 家族，实施一个有决策价值的有限真实学习比较，还是停在已有结论、转向明确定义的新问题？请比较新增训练随机性信息、改变训练预算和更改宿主/比较器的价值与实际工作量。精确参考、全面因果解释或政策搜索不是默认前置要求。

固定证据：

- [完整三种子 intake](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/d7ea795e67a52eadf1cfab2fb95dc3bcbfd25305/docs/research/candidates/vsp_c1/VSPC1_K4_FACTOR_VALUE_B01_SEED12_INTAKE_20260905.md)
- [完整结果、原始包、曲线与实际成本](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/d7ea795e67a52eadf1cfab2fb95dc3bcbfd25305/docs/research/candidates/vsp_c1/VSPC1_K4_FACTOR_VALUE_B01_SEED12_RESULT_EVIDENCE_20260905.md)
- [当前科学边界](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/d7ea795e67a52eadf1cfab2fb95dc3bcbfd25305/docs/research/candidates/vsp_c1/DIRECTION.md)

六次调用合计 17.00 秒完整 wall、14.47 CPU 秒、150048 联合步和 768 更新，均已完成。公开固定伙伴使该任务可还原为单控制器问题；GENERIC 同样共享隐藏特征，两个周期列上的四维嵌入也不构成严格低秩瓶颈。旧 A01 缺失 headroom 和旧 D6 停止边界不变。

下一轮将通过本问题的固定任务文件与独立响应分支交付完整 Convergence 原文。此时未选择新实验，也未改变 Portfolio 生命周期或优先级。

DM update for the next independent duration-value question (preparation only).

The reactive two-queue B01 pair is complete: FACTOR minus GENERIC endpoint -0.000325521, full AUC +0.000254313, one paired training instance. Both signs remain; no added B01 invocation is selected. Its recorded-tape supply upper leaves only 0.013997396 above the observed GENERIC, not tuned population headroom.

I am asking Convergence whether a single three-queue/two-worker allocation task is a useful next question, comparing the same factorized and fully conditioned value learners with a fixed same-information queue-greedy policy reference. The proposal tests allocation under scarce simultaneous coverage. It is not a task sweep, frozen card, transferred unused budget, launch or lifecycle decision. The strongest objection is that a greedy policy may again leave too little useful learning opportunity.
